item.description:
Release v5.18.0

Changes since v5.17.0

  • 移除授权界面渲染条件判断中的冗余日志
  • docs(editor): plan plugin workspace experience
  • feat: add AboutView to OpenIn plugins
  • feat: add missing AboutView and ManualView for all user-facing plugins
  • feat: add OpenInKit shared package for external app integration
  • feat: change ImageToPDF plugin policy to required and improve code formatting
  • feat: change WebServer plugin policy to required
  • feat: create 7 independent OpenIn plugins for external app integration
  • feat: hide rail for image to pdf plugin
  • feat(chat-panel): filter rail views to chat category
  • feat(chat-section): add state observation
  • feat(chat): restore image attachment preview
  • feat(code-editor): add zh-Hans translations for localizable strings
  • feat(code-editor): show project rail and chat section
  • feat(conversation-new): manage toolbar button visibility
  • feat(editor): add built-in syntax languages
  • feat(editor): add lazy project file explorer
  • feat(editor): add tabbed workspace plugin
  • feat(editor): register workspace plugin stack
  • feat(editor): restore host surface contracts
